name: SWI Group (SWI Capital Holding)
note: Transatlantic investment group formed in 2025 by the merger of Geneva-based Stoneweg and London-based Icona Capital; led by chairman/CEO Max-Hervé George. Listed on Euronext Amsterdam as SWI Capital Holding (ticker SWICH) since February 2026; holding entity in Luxembourg. Stoneweg operates as its real-assets arm.
